page.overview:
Who is Balthier?

Balthier is a playable character from Final Fantasy XII who, through unknown circumstances, ended up becoming a secret playable character in Final Fantasy Tactics: The War of the Lions. Though he is from Ivalice, Balthier is from a very different time period (just like Luso).

Balthier's default job is the sky pirate, which is a combination of the machinist and the thief jobs, as well having a wide array of equipment options and one of the highest stat growths among all jobs.

Although it is unknown how Balthier ended up in Ivalice during the War of the Lions period, it is known that he came with the intention of finding the Cache of Glabados. Unsuccessful in locating it, he began stealing precious cargo from the Church in the hope that its guards would lead him to the cache.

Shorty after fighting Meliadoul Tengille at Free City of Bervenia, Ramza Beoulve visited the Mining Town of Gollund and checked the rumor "Rash of Thefts" about a godless thief stealing precious cargo from the Church of Glabados. Ramza headed to the Merchant City of Dorter and checked the rumor "A Call For Guards" about cargo from Bervenia that needed an escort to Dorter.
